verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents developer building blocks: a CLI, a personal API key "suitable for automated workflows," a `bw serve` local REST API, and an MCP server. None of these is a product feature for creating automations that run on their own in the background; a user would have to build and schedule them with external tooling. Built-in behaviors such as TOTP rotation and authenticator sync are fixed features, not user-configured automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
